FULL TEXT:
Applications are invited for one JRF in DST-SERB sponsored project
with details given below:
Project Title: “Isolation, structural characterization and evaluation of anti-cancer
potential of selected plant lectins”
Principal Investigator: Prof. Desh Deepak Singh, Biotechnology Department, Panjab
University, BMS Block-I, Sector-25, Chandigarh Email: ddsingh@pu.ac.in
Position: Junior research fellow (JRF) one post, Salary: INR 37,000/- plus HRA as
admissible
Duration: The appointment will be initially made for a period of one year, but the tenure is
extendable up to 3 years. The selected candidate will have to join immediately.
Minimum Qualification: M.Sc. degree with at least 55% marks in Biotechnology /
Biochemistry / Microbiology / Life Sciences / M Pharm or related disciplines. The candidate
should have qualified CSIR/UGC JRF / LS or any other National Eligibility test with a valid
certificate.
Age Limit: The upper age limit for JRF shall be 28 years. Age relaxation: (SC/ST/OBC and
differently able candidates will be entitled for the relaxation in age limit as per the
government norms).
Selection process: The candidates should send their CV and covering letter addressed to
Prof. Desh Deepak Singh by email at ddsingh@pu.ac.in with a subject line: Application for
JRF position
(Last date for application 3rd May, 2024).
Candidates will be informed for interview date by email / phone.
Note 1: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
Note 2: JRF may get PhD admission after fulfilling admission criteria of Panjab University.
For any further queries please contact Prof. Desh Deepak Singh at ddsingh@pu.ac.in
Department of Biotechnology, Panjab University
BMS-1, South Campus, Sector-25, Chandigarh-160014, INDIA
Phone: 0172-2534085 Email: chairperson_biotech@pu.ac.in
